title: tocoyena cubensis
intro: Tocoyena cubensis, commonly known as Cuban toad tree, is a plant species native to Cuba. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tocoyena cubensis include flavonoids and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. Additionally, the plant has been studied for its potential to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antiviral and antifungal properties.
